nodes.label: google CLI (Gmail + Calendar v3 REST)
nodes.rationale: Event ids are Calendar API event ids, not iCalendar UIDs; ids from before the REST switch do not resolve. update/delete on an occurrence id apply to the whole series; respond never emails the guest list, only create/update/delete send attendee notifications.

nodes.label: Google Delayed Send + Undo (Gmail draft queue)
nodes.rationale: Send/reply create a Gmail draft with a pending status; google serve dispatches due drafts, and undo cancels and deletes the draft right up until dispatch begins. One persisted delay setting, not per-send.

nodes.label: EMAIL_DRAFT_ONLY Draft-Only Mode (google)
nodes.rationale: Refuses send/reply before any Gmail API call while email draft still works; calendar attendee invites remain a real outward send it does not cover.
